title: Ancient Tree Spirit
hint: Forests. Find its landmark and ritual clues.
body:
Solo health: 800.

Ritual: Moss block in a supported forest clearing; 21 by 21 clear floor and 28 blocks of height.

Requires the world dragon victory, non-Peaceful difficulty and clear space. Failed rituals preserve the summon. Read the landmark ritual book and item tooltip for preparation.

Health scales at summoning for up to four nearby Survival players. Watch attack warnings; phases change at 70% and 35% health.

A consumed heart is tracked separately from a credited kill. Fifteen different hearts finish the health track; there are sixteen families.

title: Research Bunker
hint: New Overworld plains, forests, birch forests and taigas.
body: Read the Quarantine Protocol and use the research archive. Research persists per player; an activated gate can be used by everyone.

title: Your expedition
body:
Discover creatures within 24 blocks with a clear line of sight. Enter native landmark bounds to record visits. Discoveries belong to you and survive death.

Cooking knowledge, consumed hearts and Forsaken research use your existing records. Boss defeats use Minecraft credited-kill statistics; historical shared participation cannot be reconstructed.

Refresh after exploring to update this snapshot. The Journal does not load terrain, award progress, consume items or pause the world.

title: Companion care
body:
Feed species-specific foods to build trust. Only owners ride; no saddle is needed. Sneak-use opens commands and cargo.

Breeding needs healthy adult parents of the same species and owner, both on Stay. Babies cannot be ridden. Defeated owned companions become recoverable using a Veterinary Kit.

Ownership transfer requires a nearby recipient to accept. Cargo stays with the mount. Capsule and recovery travel respect OneBlock item separation.

title: Research and travel
hint: Find an Overworld research bunker and use its archive.
body: Find a research bunker and use its archive. Repair the 5 by 5 obsidian gate border and use a Containment Key after the world dragon victory. Empty-hand use enters. The Extraction Terminal returns you near your entrance. Normal inventory and death rules apply.

title: Threats and contamination
hint: Find an Overworld research bunker and use its archive.
body: Four infected roles patrol cities. Nests drop one Parasitic Core when destroyed. Combat, explosions and breaking blocks increase shared local pressure; quiet time reduces it. Contamination lasts up to 60 seconds. Honey, milk, extraction or death clears it. Quarantine Armor shortens exposure; the full set prevents new exposure.

title: Expedition equipment
hint: Find an Overworld research bunker and use its archive.
body:
Smith Quarantine Armor from a Module template, iron armor and Biofiber. Smith the Pulse Blade from a Module, iron sword and Core. Charge Use for 1.5 seconds and release: four-block infected-only pulse, eight-second cooldown.

A Containment Beacon costs 4 Alloy, 2 Modules, 2 Redstone and 1 Data. One Core fuels five minutes within 16 blocks; existing enemies remain.

The Bio-Scanner costs 1 Alloy, 2 Data, 1 Core and 1 Redstone. Sneak-use cycles nests, resources/caches and local pressure; scans share five seconds of cooldown.

title: Resources and rewards
hint: Find an Overworld research bunker and use its archive.
body: Alloy: salvage caches. Biofiber: infected and medical caches. Core: destroyed nests. Research Data: annex and roof caches. Modules: occasional medical/research/roof cache rewards, or craft from 4 Biofiber, 2 Alloy, 2 Data and 1 Core. Caches do not restock.

title: Pirate Seas
hint: Pre-dragon ocean exploration. Craft a Sea Gate and use it in the Overworld.
body:
Sea Gate recipe: CPC / IKI / CPC. C = copper ingot, P = prismarine shard, I = iron ingot, K = compass. Place the gate on land and use it with an empty hand. No frame or dragon victory is required.

You keep your normal survival inventory. Arrive at the shared harbor at 0, 0. The glowing Harbor Return beside the plaza returns each traveler near their own entrance. Clear your cursor and trash slot and dismount before travel. If the entrance is obstructed, return attempts the Overworld spawn without breaking blocks.

The chandlery has shared, finite starter boats and supplies. Plant saplings and craft replacement boats. Sail about 190 blocks east to Castaway Cove; farther out, look for ruined forts and beached wrecks. Treasure does not refill. Use ordinary boats or build a larger vessel at the harbor Shipyard. See the Ships, Cannons and Crew overview.

Normal survival death and bed rules apply. Mark your harbor coordinates before sailing.

title: Ships, Cannons and Crew
hint: Build at the harbor Shipyard (0, 65, 24). Recruit crew while docked in the protected harbor.
body:
A small ship costs 105 oak planks plus a crafted Ship Helm. The Shipyard places a 7x15 platform 20 blocks SOUTH of the station in clear water. Build up to six blocks above its deck, at most 512 captured blocks and four cannons. Keep the full plank floor, central helm and clear passenger seats. Only wood, wool, glass, stairs/slabs/fences, ladders, lanterns and naval components can sail. Use the 27-slot hold instead of ordinary chests.

Five NPC ship victories unlock an 11x23 platform, eight blocks above deck, 1024 captured blocks and eight guns. Expand a docked ship for 148 oak planks. PvP kills grant no rank.

WASD sails; Z/C fire port/starboard; G selects a ship; U opens the hold and crew orders; R docks when stopped in clear water. Sailing uses seats for up to four players. Shift leaves your seat into the water. Walk and edit only when docked.

First mate: 12 emeralds, coordinates marked-target broadsides when ordered. Shipworker: 12 emeralds, consumes stocked oak planks to repair and reduce fire. Cannoneer: 8 emeralds each, one firing gun per gunner; captain can fire one alone. Lookout: 12 emeralds, reports loaded ships and islands up to 192 blocks. One of each specialist; four/eight cannoneers. Assigned crew are lost when the vessel sinks.

Stock solid or incendiary shot in the hold. Incendiary is selected first. Cannons consume one round each and share a three-second reload. NPC patrols approach sailing ships outside harbor. Player-owned ships are valid targets when PvP is enabled. No terrain explosions or direct player damage. Harbor radius 96 is protected. Sinking drops hold contents once; ordinary dropped-item despawn applies.

title: Breaker's Rest and the Logbound Compass
hint: Talk to Old Salt Briggs on the harbor plaza. Exploration contracts are optional.
body:
Briggs offers harbor guidance and one free calibrated Logbound Compass per player. Leave an empty inventory slot. If it is lost, bring one ordinary compass for a replacement; saved route progress is preserved.

Follow the compass east to Castaway Cove. After entering the island boundary, spend nine minutes there to recalibrate. Time pauses when you leave, die or log out. Use the compass to check destination name, horizontal distance, guided discovery count and remaining time; leaving the island shows paused. It then charts an unvisited seeded island. Study each destination to continue the route. The compass remembers visited coordinates through death and save/load. If no destination is found nearby, sail farther and retry. New terrain includes coves, forts, wrecks, beacon towers, tidal shrines and mangrove camps. Ordinary exploration remains unrestricted.

Accept the Cove Survey from Briggs or the Harbor Contract Board at 2, 65, 3. Visit Castaway Cove after accepting, then return and claim four emeralds with an empty inventory slot. The reward pays once per player. You may abandon and accept again before claiming. The survey does not require a compass or faction. Cycle contracts to inspect Pale Gull cargo (six emeralds), examine the Tideglass Shrine cache (eight), or reach Lastlight Beacon lantern platform (six). Accept before completing the objective; return here to claim once per contract. Shared, emptied caches count. Island clues are retained under Landmarks; the starter cove stays safe, while other islands have small native enemy groups.

New harbors include the Rusty Anchor tavern and market shelter. Existing harbor buildings and finite supplies are preserved. The shipyard remains south of the plaza. Faction contracts are also available: Corsair cargo, Fleet dispatches and a Drowned offering. See Factions and Captaincy for standing, earned crew prices and all three ship tiers.
